production.note: US model years 2009-2020. First: Nissan's release 'All-New 2009 Nissan NISMO 370Z Offers Racing-Inspired Performance and Style', "set to go on sale at Nissan retailers nationwide in June 2009". Continued in 2010 ("350-horsepower NISMO 370Z are also available", nissan-us-2010-370z-press-kit) and refreshed for 2015 (nissan-us-2015-370z-press-kit). Last: Nissan's '2020 Nissan 370Z NISMO Specifications' (nissan-2020-nismo-specs); as for the standard 370Z, no opened Nissan page says in so many words that 2020 was the last model year.

body.note: '2015 Nissan 370Z NISMO Coupe Specifications'. No NISMO roadster was sold.

displacementL.note: Nissan's US tables give litres only ('Displacement (liters) 3.7'); no cc figure was found on an opened Nissan page.

aspiration.note: Inferred: the sheet describes a DOHC V6 with no turbocharger or supercharger.

transmission.note: '6-speed manual' and '7-speed auto w/ manual mode and paddle shifters'. Manual only for 2009-2014 ("The NISMO 370Z is offered only with a close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission", nissan-2009-nismo-370z-release); the automatic arrived for 2015 with the NISMO Tech ("two transmission choices are offered for the first time on a Z NISMO model", nissan-us-2015-370z-press-kit).

powerHp.note: Quote: "Horsepower 350 @ 7,400 RPM". The same rating applied from launch ("the 3.7-liter VQ-series V6 produces 350 hp @ 7,400 rpm", nissan-2009-nismo-370z-release) to 2020 ("350 @ 7,400 RPM", nissan-2020-nismo-specs).

weightLb.note: 370Z NISMO (non-Tech), 6-speed manual, 2015 model. Quote (Curb (pounds) Total, columns '370Z NISMO' and '370Z NISMO Tech'): "Total 3,372 ... 3,394". The reference year is 2015, the earliest year with a Nissan weight found; 350 hp applied throughout. The 2020 sheet gives 3,457 lb (6MT) and 3,486 lb (7AT) (nissan-2020-nismo-specs).
